newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end up in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end up in lackluster trade.

text.p: Stocks ended up on modest trade and some of Colombia's leading shares posted mixed results.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index rose 0.32 percent to 18,296.33 on volume of 3.2 billion pesos. Bogota's was up a razor-thin 0.02 percent, ending at 1,201.58 on 1.5 billion pesos.
"There was no definitive pattern today. Leading stocks went down in Bogota and up in Medellin," one broker said.
Compania de Cemento Argos was up 1.25 percent in Bogota at 8,910 pesos and 1.13 percent at 8,900 pesos in Medellin on what brokers said was buying by individuals.
Colombia's two largest banks, Banco Ganadero and Banco de Colombia, both ended mixed.

Ganadero dropped 0.24 percent to 405 pesos in Bogota, but rose 0.24 percent to end at 403 pesos in Medellin. Banco de Colombia dropped 0.24 percent to 410 pesos in Bogota, but it jumped 2.75 percent to 411 pesos in Medellin on buying fueled by its lower valuation there at the start of the day.
Brewer Bavaria dropped 0.23 percent to 8.031 pesos per share in Bogota. But it eked out a tiny one centavo gain in Medellin to close at 8,020.01 pesos per share.
